Renamed from .mjs to .js so that it is served as JavaScript. Used by
js/qr.js to draw the vault recovery QR code in the page (no third-party
QR service; CSP script-src 'self'). test/site-vault.test.ts checks the
checksum above. To update: replace the file with a new release's
dist/qrcode.mjs, update this header and the checksum in the test.
